profile.name: FPGA寄存器通信接口
profile.description: 用于通过 USB 与 FPGA 设备进行寄存器级读写的非物理软件接口组件。它在实验系统中提供底层地址访问、连接状态检查以及获取底层设备对象的能力，适合用于控制或调试依赖 FPGA 的仪器模块。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software interface component for register-level communication with an FPGA over USB. In laboratory systems, it provides low-level address read/write access, connection checking, and access to the underlying device object, making it useful for controlling or debugging FPGA-based instrument modules.

registry.name: Communication interface for the FPGA
registry.description: Register Interface是一款实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括写入数据、设备连接、读取数据。支持Signal, Slot, format to int等操作。
